posts.author: -Bug
posts.title: Re: Who likes Airsoft?
posts.html:
Kiz, first fo all, you linked to a 50$ airsoft.

Airsoft is more expensive if you play real airsoft, i agree, speedball aka paintball with airsoft weapons is fuckt, but milsim which is what airsoft is made for, is fucking epic and could never be done with paintball weapons.

Airsoft is all in all more expensive than paintball. Paintball got standart weapons, which isn't very espensive compared to REAL airsoft guns, scopes and such accessories.

My G18C with metal alide is 2500 DKK, + 700 DKK silencer, + 400 DKK flashlight. thats 3600 DKK, 1$ ~ 5,5 DKK.

My riffle isn't done yet, but its around the 5500 at the moment, so that will be 1000$ for the riffle alone, so some quick calculations tells me around 1500$ for the weapons, and don't get me started on the gear! that's evrything between $200 - $5000.

EDIT: Milsim = Military simulation.
